concepts.definition: All the money you receive each month.
concepts.example: Allowance from parents + part-time job pay.

concepts.definition: Costs that stay about the same every month.
concepts.example: Rent, phone plan, monthly bus pass.

concepts.definition: Costs that change from month to month.
concepts.example: Food, fuel, going out with friends.

concepts.definition: Things you must pay for to live and study.
Nice-to-have things you could live without.
concepts.example: Milk tea, new clothes, concert tickets.

concepts.definition: Money you set aside for goals and emergencies.

quiz.question: Which one is a fixed expense?
quiz.explanation: Rent is the same amount every month, so it is fixed.

quiz.question: A large milk tea every afternoon is a...
quiz.explanation: It is nice to have, but you can live and study without it.

quiz.question: With the 50/30/20 rule and an income of 4,000,000 VND, how much should you save?
Which one counts as income?
quiz.explanation: Income is money coming in. The other two are expenses.

quiz.question: "Pay yourself first" means...
options: Save first, then spend the rest
quiz.explanation: Move money into savings as soon as you get paid, before spending.
